description: React component implementing a Kanban column, handling title editing, deletion, and displaying associated cards.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates the new column title to ensure it's not empty, whitespace, or unchanged.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Begins inline editing of the column title on double-click or edit button click.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Saves the new column title after validation, updating via updateColumn and handling errors.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles key events (Enter, Escape) during inline editing of the title.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Triggers the display of the delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs the deletion of the column and shows success toast.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
